title: boehmeria trinervata
intro: Boehmeria trinervata, commonly known as Three-veined nettle or Trinervia, is a plant species in the nettle family Urticaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Boehmeria trinervata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and vasodilatory properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. Boehmeria trinervata contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
